pages.text: Issues can be reported $(l:https://github.com/xt9/CryogenicSimulation-Tracker/issues)here$().$(br2)Issues with mods should be reported to their respective issue tracker, not the modpacks issue tracker.$(br2)Some issues may never be solved since $(item)Cryogenic Simulation$() is a $(item)1.12.2$() modpack and a lot of mods do no longer offer support for this version.

However, where appropriate the pack has chosen "extended life" mods where appropriate.$(br2)Additionally it has been a design philosophy of the pack to stick to battletested mods that have few bugs at this point.$(br2)$(item)Cryogenic Simulation$() should be a stable experience.
